title: Ancient Stone Circle

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Ancient Stone Circles can be found within the Meadows Biome and consists of 5 large stone pillars protruding from the ground arranged in a circle.
The formation has no specific purpose, and there is no chest buried in the center. However, the stone pillars are indestructible and provide maximum support for building.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: • Ancient Stone Circles were intended to be the only places where portals could be summoned by throwing a Greydwarf eye into Campfire[1]. They also had a central altar that would give a gift when enough Greydwarfs were killed nearby. Ultimately, these features were abandoned, but the structures remained.[2]

Ancient Stone Circle

Type: Point of interest | Internal ID: StoneCircle | Stone1_huge (Stone) | Location: Meadows

Introduction. Ancient Stone Circles can be found within the Meadows Biome and consists of 5 large stone pillars protruding from the ground arranged in a circle.
The formation has no specific purpose, and there is no chest buried in the center. However, the stone pillars are indestructible and provide maximum support for building.

Trivia. • Ancient Stone Circles were intended to be the only places where portals could be summoned by throwing a Greydwarf eye into Campfire[1]. They also had a central altar that would give a gift when enough Greydwarfs were killed nearby. Ultimately, these features were abandoned, but the structures remained.[2]
